output.summary: On 2016-12-02, transaction 3506725 for $1,000.03 was flagged by a real‑time model with a risk score of 0.9 (trigger:case_pack). The graph showed the transaction is online, from an anonymous email domain, in the customer’s established region (Q02-region_history) but the amount has no prior similar transactions (Q04-amount_profile) and the model’s historical prior suggests such scores are usually legitimate (trigger:case_pack). The agent returned an uncertain verdict with a fraud probability of 0.35. Because the verdict is uncertain and exposure exceeds $500, the final actions are to verify with the customer, monitor the card, and escalate to an analyst.
why_these_actions: VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER [R1]: policy requires verification when fraud probability <0.70 and the case rests on a single signal.
MONITOR_CARD [R4]: no customer reply within 24 hours triggers monitoring and decline for pending authorizations when exposure >$500.
ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST [R8]: uncertain verdict with exposure >$500 or conflicting evidence requires escalation.
